$comment: A derived template (packs/README.md 'Derived templates'): the services-recurring pack composed with a pest-control content seed and a brick-red brand over the warm-boutique register. Everything else — pages, sections, contract, tests — is the base pack's; compose expands this catalog through resolveCatalog (scripts/lib/pack-switch.mjs).
title: Pest control
description: A pest control site built around the schedule: quarterly and monthly protection plans priced per visit, a line-by-line plan comparison, a proof gallery, testimonials, and a booking form that asks for a frequency, not a project — a multi-page site edited in one content file.

theme.$comment: Brick red over the warm-boutique register's espresso dark — the protective, urgent voice of the trade, opened after dark when the pests come out. mode dark selects the register's candlelit appearance (espresso ground, cream type, the red as embers; the appearance toggle still swaps to the cream daylight). Marketing pages resolve brand over preset accent, so the overlay re-skins the pages and the app surfaces together. navigation re-pins the shared servicesRecurringShell chrome (a declared theme variant outranks the shell prop): the base cleaner wears the pill-links cluster, so the pest remix takes the centered masthead — the nav-variety audit spreads the nine-template services family across the vocabulary.
